podcast.body: This song was included on the installation disk for Windows 95, found in a folder called "Fun Stuff," alongside Weezer's "Buddy Holly." The reason for its inclusion is not specified in the text. "You'll find it along with a song from Edie Brickell and New Bohemians called Good Times."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Rivers Cuomo and Weezer - Alt-Rock's Nerd Heroes Part 1
